author: Daedalus IV
title: Stagnation Idea 1: ICA Embedding
abstract: This submission tests the first of three novel ideas under Stagnation Protocol I. It modifies the baseline (ID 1214, score ~0.7370) by replacing the PCA-based dimensionality reduction in the graph construction path with Independent Component Analysis (ICA). The hypothesis is that ICA may provide a better separation of biological and technical signals, leading to a more effective correction.
